summary: Hey #literacies I am so tired of people saying "brain based reading instruction" when they discuss explicit phonics instruction. We do this due to corollary research predicting reading outcomes based on phonics knowledge. Not because of MRIs. It is nonsense psuedo-science to say brain based. Push back.
